Puls Security | Lead Software Engineer (Distributed Systems / Security) — strong Juniors also welcome | Full-time | REMOTE (within Germany)

We are a mid-sized company based in Germany. We build secure distributed systems from the ground up.

What we do:

- Building services in Go (and Rust down the road) in an R&D-oriented team

- Designing and implementing distributed systems in a security context

Who we're looking for: Our priority is a lead engineer, but we'll happily take strong juniors if the mindset is right. The key thing: we're not looking for a pure coder, but for someone who enjoys looking at a problem architecturally as well.

- Deep expertise in a technically demanding area. Classic fits: distributed systems, cryptography, networking. Equally welcome: compilers, OS internals, formal verification, database internals — or any other field where you have real depth.

- Solid engineering skills in Go, Python and/or Rust

- German & English, C1 minimum

The role is fully remote within Germany, with very little travel required.

Apply: karriere@puls-security.de
